observedActions.action: Removed the unified Mobile active .env containing a machine-specific private-LAN HTTP API endpoint; retained .env.example using the canonical local placeholder.
Checked-in service Provider .env is limited to local TEST/SQLite operation and no populated API key, signing key, backend result URL or encryption key is supplied there.
Mobile Maps API keys are blank in example configuration; live API keys are not embedded in the source baseline.
Source package excludes certificate/private-key file formats, generated builds, package caches, Git metadata, documents and bundled images.

requiredAtFinalReview: Run external secret scanning and review findings without putting secret values in logs/reports.
Rotate any credential proven to have been exposed in prior archives or environments.
Configure local Android emulator/device API host only in a machine-local ignored .env; do not recommit private-LAN URLs.
Obtain/restrict map/provider credentials outside source and verify platform package/API restrictions.
Verify TEST and LIVE credentials are distinct; no production/live secret is shipped in source or app bundle.

implementedControls.control: Selected database URL must parse as PostgreSQL; TEST requires a loopback host and cannot connect to a remote database target.
Invalid RIDEX_ENVIRONMENT input is not echoed in startup errors.
Every explicit DATABASE_URL_TEST is validated as PostgreSQL and loopback-only; selected DB targets cannot use a generic DATABASE_URL fallback.
Production startup refuses loopback/invalid DATABASE_URL_LIVE targets and requires remote PostgreSQL.

knownResiduals: Environment variable presence is not proof of secret ownership, rotation, or deployment isolation; credential scan, runtime endpoint evidence, and production approval remain pending.
